title: Lunch Under the Trees
kicker: GPT 独立第 1 组 · 第 1 篇
how: 这是 GPT 自己选材的第 1 组。先顺读故事；点黄色词听有道发音，必要时展开中文。读完遮住正文做回忆题，再说一件自己的事。

paras.en: On Saturday morning, Mina wanted to have a [[picnic|/ˈpɪknɪk/]] for her sister's birthday. Her [[budget|/ˈbʌdʒɪt/]] was small, and she could not [[afford|/əˈfɔːd/]] to eat at a restaurant. [[To save money]], she [[decided|/dɪˈsaɪdɪd/]] to make lunch herself.
paras.cn: 周六早上，米娜想在妹妹生日时办一次野餐。她预算不多，去餐厅吃饭负担不起。为了省钱，她决定自己做午餐。

paras.en: Her brother Leo [[recommended|/ˌrekəˈmendɪd/]] a [[grocery store]] two [[blocks|/blɒks/]] from home. Mina was [[in a hurry]]; it was [[almost|/ˈɔːlməʊst/]] eleven. She [[made sure]] she had her list and bought bread, fruit, and a [[snack|/snæk/]] for each person. The bread there was [[not as expensive as]] the bread near the park.
paras.cn: 哥哥利奥推荐了一家离家两个街区的杂货店。米娜赶时间，快十一点了。她确认带了清单，买了面包、水果和每人一份小吃。那里的面包没有公园附近的贵。

paras.en: At home, she [[wrapped|/ræpt/]] the sandwiches and put them in a bag. The fruit was [[already|/ɔːlˈredi/]] in it. Leo called. "I can [[pick you up]] at eleven thirty." "Thanks. I'm ready now," Mina said.
paras.cn: 回到家，她把三明治包好放进袋子，水果已经在袋里了。利奥打来电话：「我十一点半来接你。」「谢谢，我现在准备好了。」米娜说。

paras.en: At the park, they [[came across]] an old friend by the gate. "Eat with us!" Mina said. They arrived [[in time]] for lunch. A [[crowd|/kraʊd/]] sat at the tables, but Leo [[spotted|/ˈspɒtɪd/]] a quiet place under a tree.
paras.cn: 在公园门口，他们偶然遇到一位老朋友。「和我们一起吃吧！」米娜说。他们赶上了午餐时间。桌子都被一群人占了，但利奥发现树下有个安静的地方。

paras.en: The [[wind|/wɪnd/]] lifted their [[blanket|/ˈblæŋkɪt/]]. Leo [[held|/held/]] one corner while Mina set out the food. "This picnic is [[as good as]] a big party," her sister said. Mina smiled. "I really [[appreciate|/əˈpriːʃieɪt/]] your help, Leo."
paras.cn: 风把他们的野餐毯掀了起来。利奥按住一角，米娜摆好食物。妹妹说：「这次野餐和大聚会一样棒。」「利奥，真的谢谢你帮忙。」米娜笑了。

focus.core: 句首先说目的，后面再说行动；省钱和做午餐的是同一个人。
forms: To save money, she decided to make lunch herself.
To find a gift within her budget, she looked at used books.（第 3 篇）
focus.warn: 句首 To save money 回答『为什么自己做』，不是另一个人的目的。

focus.core: 拿两家店的面包比较价格；最后把野餐和聚会比较。
forms: The bread was not as expensive as the bread near the park.
This picnic is as good as a big party.
focus.warn: 两处 as 中间用原级 expensive / good，不说 as more expensive as。

focus.core: 买东西时赶，最后还是赶上了午餐；前者是状态，后者是结果。
forms: They arrived in time for lunch.
focus.warn: in time 是来得及；on time 才是按约定时刻准点。

focus.core: 利奥来接米娜，不是『捡起米娜』。
forms: I can pick you up at eleven thirty.
She needed to pick up her little brother from school at four.（第 3 篇）
focus.warn: 代词放中间：pick you up；不说 pick up you。

focus.core: 钱的总额度有限，所以不去餐厅。
forms: She could not afford to eat at a restaurant.
focus.warn: afford 后常接 to do：can't afford to eat out。

drills.cn: 为了省钱，她决定自己做午餐。
drills.en: [[To save money]], she decided to make lunch herself.

drills.cn: 那里的面包没有公园附近的贵。
drills.en: The bread there was [[not as expensive as]] the bread near the park.

drills.cn: 他们来得及和朋友一起吃午饭。
drills.en: They arrived [[in time]] to eat with their friend.
I can [[pick you up]] at eleven thirty.

speak.q: 说一个你为了省钱而做过的选择。
speak.a: To save money, I made lunch at home.

speak.q: 说一次你赶时间，但最终来得及的经历。
speak.a: I was in a hurry, but I arrived in time.

speak.q: 比较两种你真的买过的东西，用 not as ... as。
speak.a: This bag is not as expensive as my old one.
